# market — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Market data: prices, charts, wallet PnL. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl market <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### market price
Get token price (by contract address)
`ocl market price --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. ethereum, solana, xlayer)

### market prices
Get prices for multiple tokens (POST, batch query)
`ocl market prices --tokens <TOKENS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Default chain if not specified per token

### market kline
Get K-line / candlestick data
`ocl market kline --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--bar <BAR>` — Bar size: 1s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1H, 4H, 1D, 1W, etc (default 1H)
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Number of data points (max 299) (default 100)
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain

### market index
Get index price (aggregated from multiple sources)
`ocl market index --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain

### market portfolio-supported-chains
Get supported chains for portfolio PnL endpoints
`ocl market portfolio-supported-chains`

### market portfolio-overview
Get wallet portfolio overview: realized/unrealized PnL, win rate, trading stats
`ocl market portfolio-overview --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--time-frame <TIME_FRAME>` — Time frame: 1=1D, 2=3D, 3=7D, 4=1M, 5=3M (default: 4 = 1M) (default 4)

### market portfolio-dex-history
Get wallet DEX transaction history (paginated)
`ocl market portfolio-dex-history --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--begin <BEGIN>` — Start timestamp (milliseconds)
- `--end <END>` — End timestamp (milliseconds)
- `--since <SINCE>` — Relative time window: <int><s|m|h|d>, e.g. 24h, 7d
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Page size (1-100, default 20)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor from previous response
- `--token <TOKEN>` — Filter by token contract address
- `--tx-type <TX_TYPE>` — Transaction type: 1=BUY, 2=SELL, 3=Transfer In, 4=Transfer Out (comma-separated)

### market portfolio-recent-pnl
Get recent token PnL records for a wallet (paginated)
`ocl market portfolio-recent-pnl --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Page size (1-100, default 20)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor from previous response

### market portfolio-token-pnl
Get latest PnL snapshot for a specific token in a wallet
`ocl market portfolio-token-pnl --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> --token <TOKEN>`
